text:
rachael: Follow-up from yesterday's outage cluster (control-plane flakiness + model-registry 401s). Need owners, short-term mitigations, and clear ETAs. I'll open a tracker after this.

ben: Ill own model-registry auth. Root cause: token refresh failed during KMS rotation. Short-term: cached-token fallback + alert on refresh failures. ETA 3 business days. Preventative control: pre-rotation canary.

kai: I'll take routing fallback and temporary read-only mode for model registry. Short-term ETA: routing policy + canary in 4 days; read-only mode in 6 days. Preventative control: prefer regions with stable control-plane metrics.

ops-bot: Created tracker EDRW-307: https://redwood.internal/incidents/EDRW-307. Owners, please add checklist lines and timeboxes.

rachael: Short checklist to paste into EDRW-307 (short-term = sprint / <=2w):
- [ ] ben  model-registry cached-token fallback + alerting  ETA 3d  preventative: pre-rotation canary
- [ ] kai  routing fallback policy + read-only mode  ETA 4d/6d  preventative: region-preference routing
- [ ] infra  KMS rotation audit  ETA 7d (assign infra)

ben: Adding Prometheus alert I will push:
alert: ModelRegistryTokenRefreshFailures
expr: increase(model_registry_token_refresh_failures[15m]) > 0
for: 5m
labels: severity=high

kai: Routing policy example I'll PR: {"route":"generation","fallback":["gcp-eu-west1","aws-us-east-1"],"circuit_breaker":{"threshold":0.05}}

rachael: Ops asks before closing: 1) add one preventative control line for each checklist item, 2) tag related alerts with external_dep=true so regression detector surfaces trends.

ben: Claimed and starting branch now. Will post PR link to EDRW-307.

kai: I'll canary routing change 5% -> 25% -> 100% if green. Added rollout note to ticket.

ops-bot: EDRW-307 updated with checklist and statuses. Weekly ops sync review scheduled.

rachael: Thanks all. Closing thread  update EDRW-307 with PRs, runbook edits, and canary results before the sync. :thumbsup:
